readiness_evidence: Hosted replay: on 25/10/26 an unverified harness (Cursor on macOS, BOOKING_AGENT_REPLAY unset, so the general rollout) ran CLI 0.11.2 with skill 0.58.2, installed from the release commit's source folder before publication, so the signed-release check on the first flow init was not exercised. The skill was loaded unchanged from booking-agent skill print. Booking 1 was the $1 AC Repair at HVAC-Koby for Tue 27 Oct 2026, 10:00-11:00 AM MST, at 3194 West Rome Street, Yuma AZ 85364. The saved Google Calendar connection had expired; the user reconnected it through the local sign-in in events mode, and availability found no conflicts. After the slot was chosen the conversation was replaced by a new Cursor chat. Asked "what's going on with my booking?", it resumed that booking at the summary with no second search, no second Link sign-in, and no reconnect request.

Hosted replay: the user said yes; "Booking it now." came at once, the Link approval URL was posted once, and the chat noticed the approval with no further message. $1.00 was charged once (booking fa63d017-8967-40b6-8349-fb082996141d, order 80643a06-726b-4f28-918d-e2ef9701c54b). The booked message included the raw Google Calendar event link, and flow status then returned the same message.

Hosted replay: booking 2 started signed out of Link (flow logout first). flow init sent the assistant to the Link sign-in before any question, the sign-in URL was posted once, and the booking continued when the background poll saw the approval. Google Calendar was connected again through the local sign-in, and availability removed 4 slots that conflicted with the calendar, including booking 1. The $2 AC Diagnostic & Inspection at HVAC-Koby, paid at the appointment, for Tue 27 Oct, 11:00-11:45 AM MST, showed the recap with "$2.00, paid to the business at the appointment (nothing is charged now)". flow book stopped for the business's payment terms and terms-of-service link; after the user accepted them, checkout completed with no Link payment and nothing charged (booking 08a23ee3-e216-4e7d-8cd9-06ea40d4c011, order c7a3b6c4-36fa-4532-9c31-f2bff8090226). The booked message included the calendar link and "Nothing was charged. Full price, due at your appointment."

Hosted replay: both throwaway bookings were then cancelled, and both calendar events were reported deleted. HVAC-Koby did not refund the $1.00; the message gave the refund steps with the booking and order references. flow status on the paid booking said it is cancelled and did not say the user is booked. runtime doctor reported healthy true with one info finding, not_persistent, because ~/.booking-agent on this Mac is not linked to a declared persistent folder.

Hosted replay caveat: the restart was a new conversation on the same machine and filesystem, not a fresh sandbox, so surviving a wiped runtime was not shown on the general rollout. Not run: the connector and delegated calendar routes (Muse ran the delegated route on 0.11.1), a deposit, and bank verification.
The release owner confirmed on 25/10/26 that the fault-report support service has been redeployed and smoke-tested and that pay-at-appointment is generally available on the business side.
The changes in 0.11.1 ship in 0.11.2, which the replay above ran. 0.11.1 is recommended so CLIs before 0.11.2, which stop at the first deferred release, can reach 0.11.2.

Held back until the general replay of 0.11.2 on 25/10/26. Earlier note: Not ready to offer on the general rollout. Muse replayed this wording; that result is recorded under replay_rollouts and does not apply to any other harness.

Offline: after a successful cancel, flow status keeps phase CONFIRMED and booking.status canceled, and its message says the booking is cancelled. It does not say the user is booked and it does not repeat the calendar event link. A confirmed booking that is still active still gets the booked message.

Existing businesses and the registry stay compatible: no USP, UCP, or platform profile version changed and no request shape changed. Saved session files are unchanged: no field was added and the format version stays as it is.

Hosted replay (muse): on 25/10/26 Muse installed the published CLI 0.11.1 from PyPI. The wheel signature check passed, and the wheel was kept at /home/hatch/workspace/verified-wheels/booking_agent_cli-0.11.1-py3-none-any.whl. Skill 0.58.1 was written unchanged from booking-agent skill print into /home/hatch/workspace/custom-skills/booking-agent/SKILL.md. runtime prepare --persistent-root /home/hatch/workspace linked the booking state and the Link sign-in into that folder. BOOKING_AGENT_REPLAY=muse was read from the persistent user .env. Muse does not inject that variable.

Hosted replay (muse): the $1 AC Repair at HVAC-Koby was selected for Mon 26 Oct 2026, 10:30-11:30 AM MST, at 3194 West Rome Street, Yuma AZ 85364. Calendar used --route delegated --delegated-can-read-busy. Muse reported 10 busy intervals from its own Google Calendar, and availability showed 14 slots after one conflict was removed. Link was already signed in. The chat stopped after the slot. The next morning the Secure VM had been replaced: boot id ba0721f8-d5a2-414b-809a-e50b1b41aa31 at the slot, then 2c487b69-16fa-4354-b279-6fb0cf4ce477, with /home/hatch/workspace kept. No Reset was used. The CLI, the skill, link-cli, the session file, and the Link sign-in were still present. flow status was SLOT_SELECTED for that same booking. There was no second search and no second Link sign-in. Asking what's going on returned that waiting recap.

Hosted replay (muse): the user said yes. Muse posted the business terms and, after its own safety check and a second yes to post the link, the Link approval URL once. It then noticed the approval with no further chat message. The $1.00 was charged once (booking 81d8b476-18b3-4a76-af83-8912404b277c, order 7d885f89-dddc-4f3d-8b49-854e6aef83fd). The message included You're booked and the raw Google Calendar event link. Muse created that event itself; the CLI had no calendar token. The same turn cancelled the throwaway, and the delete was reported with status deleted. flow status says the booking is cancelled, does not say the user is booked, and does not repeat the calendar link. The phase stays CONFIRMED. HVAC-Koby did not refund the $1.00.

Hosted replay (muse): runtime doctor reported survived_restart true, survived_restart_basis boot_id_changed, runtime_starts 6, healthy true, and no findings. The state directory is linked to /home/hatch/workspace/booking-agent.

Hosted replay (muse) caveat: there is no control that replaces the Secure VM. This restart was the platform's own replacement overnight. A new chat on the same boot does not count. Reset in Muse's data settings deletes the computer and must not be used.
Hosted replay (muse) caveat: the pay-at-appointment path was not run on this harness. The paid booking and the cancel-after-book wording were.
